content:
maya: Quick sync — Mosaic renewal tomorrow. We need a crisp SLO one-pager + the exact credit calculation example they can include in procurement docs. cc @jules @owen @zara

jules: I can own the SLO wording. Quick q: do we use p95 over 7d or 30d for onboarding customers?

owen: For onboarding we default to p95 7d for latency and rolling 30d for uptime. Customer can request different windows but that changes sensitivity.

maya: Mosaic asked for uptime 99.95% and p95 latency 150ms in the contract ask. They also want a numeric credit example (how much they'd get if uptime slipped to 99.80%).

zara: I can draft the one-pager and the customer-facing email. Need the formula and a short example line. Do we credit against monthly committed $ or token usage?

jules: We credit against the committed monthly subscription (typical). Formula we use internally: credit = clamp((SLO_target - observed) / SLO_target, 0, 1) * monthly_commitment * credit_cap

jules: Example (to paste into the doc):
```
SLO: uptime_target = 99.95%
observed_uptime = 99.80%
monthly_commitment = $20,000
credit_cap = 0.25  # max 25% of monthly
credit = ((99.95 - 99.80) / 99.95) * 20000 * 0.25
# credit ≈ (0.15 / 99.95) * 20000 * 0.25 ≈ $7.50 (rounded)
```

jules: Note — we round to nearest dollar and include a single-line description in the invoice.

owen: Also flag: automatic fallback to regional model variant can cause transient p95 spikes; those are considered successful requests (not downtime) but we should include an explanatory footnote in the one-pager so procurement understands the difference.

maya: Great — include a short 'causes and mitigations' bullet and a sample chart. @deploy-bot can you pull last 7d p95 for mosaic-prod so we can attach it?

deploy-bot: Requested: `/metrics p95 mosaic-prod 7d` — result: link to chart https://dash.redwood/prod/mosaic/p95?range=7d (access: mosaic-customer-view)

jules: I'll review the chart and confirm the numbers. ETA ~25m.

zara: I'll prepare the one-pager draft and email copy; will post here for sign-off once jules confirms numbers.

maya: Action items: jules (confirm observed uptime & p95 + final example calc), owen (short fallback note + causes/mitigations), zara (one-pager + email). I'll take outreach and send final to Mosaic. Back in 45m for approvals. :thumbsup:
